results.title: Maharashtra: Tukaram Mundhe-Led FDA Cracks Down On Vimal Ad, Issues Notices To SRK, Ajay Devgn & Tiger Shroff
results.description: Maharashtra FDA has issued show-cause notices to Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff over their association with a 2024 Vimal Elaichi advertisement. FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe said the campaign may indirectly promote Vimal, a brand associated with pan masala, prohibited in Maharashtra. The actors have 15 days to remove promotional content.

results.title: QSL 2 rebranded as Jetour League
results.description:
Doha, Qatar: The Qatar Stars League (QSL) and Jetour announced a two-season sponsorship agreement, making it the Official Sponsor and naming rights holder of QSL 2 league, officially renaming it as Jetour League.

The agreement aligns with QSL’s strategic plan to develop its competitions, enhance their marketing and commercial value, and expand its partnerships with leading brands, thereby supporting the development of Qatar football.

Under the agreement, both entities will collaborate on several marketing and commercial initiatives and activities over the next two seasons, contributing to increased tournament attendance and fan engagement, and generating added value for both.

QSL Sales, Marketing and Communication Executive Director Hassan Rabiah Al Kuwari said, “We welcome Jetour to our list of partners and are proud of this agreement, which represents a significant addition to QSL’s commercial sponsorship portfolio. We look forward to a fruitful collaboration over the next two seasons, which’ll contribute to enhancing the tournament’s presence and development, and achieving the shared goals of both parties.”

Zaid Al Qatami, Vice-President, Al Waha for Cars, said, “We’re proud to partner QSL because we believe in supporting rising stars. Just as Jetour is a fast-growing global brand, we want to help create opportunities for the next generation of football talent in Qatar. We look forward to being part of their journey and celebrating their success
